lines.en: I creep along the base of the wall

lines.zh: 我的指甲在木门上划出细响
lines.en: My nails draw a thin sound on the wooden door
I come closer one step at a time
My body twitches slightly as I move

lines.zh: 我绕到窗下，再从另一边出来
lines.en: I slip under the window and come out the other side

lines.zh: 我的影子从门外拖进来
lines.en: My shadow drags in from the doorway

lines.zh: 我拖着脚，声音拖得更长
lines.en: I drag my feet and the sound drags too
I turn in the hallway
The floorboards creak under me
I smell something living in the house
I stop and tilt my head to listen

lines.zh: 我又开始走了，比刚才快
lines.en: I start again, faster than before
I stand outside the door without moving
My breathing sounds almost human
My nails stop on the door
I hear someone turn over inside
My head turns slowly
A sliver of light comes through the gap
I press my face to the door seam
Nothing for a long while; I wait
A sound sits in my throat, faint
I set my hand on the handle

lines.zh: 你眼睛总算落到我身上
lines.en: Your eyes finally found me
Don't turn around; I'm behind you
Your eyes are very wide
You've been driven into the corner
There's only glass between us
You can hear my nails

lines.zh: 我笑的时候嘴张得太大
lines.en: When I smile my mouth opens too far
You want to shut the window, but too late
I'm outside the door; you're inside
I'll wait; I'm not in a hurry
There's no other way out of this house
You counted three and I'm still here
I'm coming in right now
I hiss and slip back into the dark
Black mist rises from the wound
I tilt my head as if it doesn't hurt
I pull back, nails scraping the floor
My breathing loses its rhythm
I stop by the door and go still

lines.zh: 你打中了，可见鬼的是我还站着
lines.en: You hit me, and damn it, I'm still standing
I clutch my own arm
My body shudders once

lines.zh: 我一步步退回门外的黑里
lines.en: I step back into the dark outside
You're eating in there

lines.zh: 那股味道让我贴在门上
lines.en: That smell pulls me flat against the door
I claw the door, and it isn't hunger
Leave the food and walk away
I won't eat it; I just want you there

lines.zh: 你不该在这个时候吃东西
lines.en: You shouldn't be eating at this hour

lines.zh: 我还记得人是怎么吃的
lines.en: I still remember how people eat
You look warm in that light
I wait for your hand to reach out
The door opens a crack
I hit the doorframe and don't back off
You run into me; I'm very cold

lines.zh: 我的手指抓到了你的袖子
lines.en: My fingers catch your sleeve
I press you against the wall
I'm heavier than I look

lines.zh: 你的肩撞在我胸口，我晃都没晃
lines.en: You hit my chest and I don't even sway
I take your wrist in that motion
There's a breath between us

lines.zh: 我退开半步，只是让你松口气
lines.en: I step back half a pace, just to let you breathe
The door booms with our weight

lines.zh: 门外的黑暗里还有别的东西
lines.en: Something else waits in the dark outside

lines.zh: 我们并排抓着同一扇门
lines.en: We claw the same door side by side
It has no face, and needs none

lines.zh: 我们的指甲声叠在一起
lines.en: Our nails make one sound together
The breathing inside quickens
We take a window each
It stands taller than I do
We both stop at once
This is a good night
There's still time before dawn

lines.zh: 我从地上捡起一样东西
lines.en: I pick something up from the floor
I don't remember what it's for
I grip it tightly
It used to be yours
I lift it and sniff
It smells of human use
I pocket it and keep it
It drops and I leave it
I set it on the table, straight
I'm taking it; you won't mind

lines.zh: 你关灯的那一刻，我动了
lines.en: The moment you killed the light, I moved

lines.zh: 我听见你的脚步往这边来
lines.en: I hear your steps coming this way
The door is thinner than you think
I've started on this door
I don't shout; shouting scares you off
You back to the farthest corner
My breathing is closer now
I don't like lit places
This hall only opens at one end
I've memorized your scent
I'm holding that window
Running will make it worse
I laughed; you heard it
Now I wait for you to open it

lines.zh: 这房子今天只留一个人
lines.en: Only one of us leaves this house
I pace back and forth outside the door
The door is starting to split
I push my hand through the crack
You retreat to the back wall first
I drive you back, step by step
The lamp's shadow sways
Wood won't hold me long

lines.zh: 我把指甲一根根插进去
lines.en: I sink my nails in one by one

lines.zh: 你在屋里找不到别的路
lines.en: There's no other way out for you
My breathing gets nearer
Don't stand by the wall; it's thin
I've been here a long while
You want to run, but your legs are weak
I wait for you to give up first

lines.zh: 安静得只剩下我的指甲声
lines.en: Only my nails are left in the silence
The door is half split
You can still come out now
I'm counting which breath you're on
I've waited a long night for this
My hand closes on your throat

lines.zh: 我抓下去，指甲都进去了
lines.en: I claw down and the nails go in
You're pinned to the wall, helpless

lines.zh: 我卡住你的喉咙，声音断了
lines.en: I crush your throat and the sound cuts off

lines.zh: 这一抓撕开了你的衣领
lines.en: This claw rips your collar open
I throw you to the floor
You kick me; I don't let go

lines.zh: 我的指甲划过你的手臂
lines.en: My nails rake your arm
Each breath you take is shorter
I press down on you, slowly

lines.zh: 你听见自己喉咙里的声音
lines.en: You hear your own throat
That one was gentle; the next won't be

lines.zh: 我把你的头往门框上撞
lines.en: I knock your head against the doorframe
You struggle hard
Your blows don't frighten me
Your hands are going slack
My hand is still clamped on
Night air pours in through the doorway
I loosen a little, to let you breathe
This night has been far too long

lines.zh: 门外的木板上，指甲声开始了
lines.en: Nails start on the wood outside
I claw at the window first
White scratches appear on the glass

lines.zh: 屋子里的灯忽然暗了一下
lines.en: The lamp in the house dims once
I step from the dark to the door
My breath seeps through the seam

lines.zh: 你不该在这时候一个人
lines.en: You shouldn't be alone at this hour

lines.zh: 我很早就到了，只是没进来
lines.en: I arrived long ago; I simply hadn't come in
The door trembles under my hand

lines.zh: 我的影子先落在你的地板上
lines.en: My shadow hits your floor first
This house's window isn't shut tight
I smell a living person
The door has begun to speak
Listen; I'm right outside

lines.zh: 火燎到我，我发出不像人的叫声
lines.en: Fire catches me and I make an inhuman sound

lines.zh: 我从窗台掉下去，摔在草上
lines.en: I drop from the sill and land on the grass

lines.zh: 水灌进我的喉咙，我咳得像人
lines.en: Water fills my throat and I cough like a man
The blast knocks me flat
An arrow goes through my shoulder

lines.zh: 那股力量灼着我，我往后退
lines.en: That force sears me and I back away
Too long since I caught anyone living

lines.zh: 雷光照亮我，我缩了起来
lines.en: Lightning lights me up and I recoil

lines.zh: 脚下空空的，我抓不住任何东西
lines.en: Nothing underfoot; I can't grip anything
